# Vendored TMLR style

Source: <https://github.com/JmlrOrg/tmlr-style-file>

The files `tmlr.sty`, `tmlr.bst`, `fancyhdr.sty` and `LICENSE` are copied
verbatim from the official TMLR style repository. They must not be edited.
To update, replace the files wholesale from a pinned upstream revision, record
that revision here, and compile/visually inspect the dissertation again.
